notes:
What's new in DuckOS 1.0.112

• Face: when your face isn't recognised the first time, DuckOS simply looks again by itself — no "Try again" button, and no "Continue" to tap after it works (DuckWallet, Passwords, DuckConnections, app lock, passkeys).
• DuckWallet: pull an open card down to go back to all your cards — it flies back into the pile.
• DuckWallet: hold a card to lift it, move it up or down the pile, and let go; the other cards slide out of the way, and the order is kept.
